basic_info.description: Exceptional Views, Extraordinary Opportunity! Perched at the serene end of a quiet street in coveted Miraloma Park, this expansive midcentury gem boasts breathtaking, panoramic views of the city skyline, bay and beyond. Spanning three spacious levels of living, this home offers incredible versatility, comfort, and convenience. The main level features a bright and open layout with a generous living room (complete w/cozy fireplace for chilly SF nights), dining area, eat-in kitchen, and three well-proportioned bedrooms plus two full baths. On the street level (accessed via the 2 car garage), a massive family room along with a full bath & laundry area provides the ideal space for relaxing or entertaining. The lower level includes a fourth bedroom/home office or craft area, offering privacy and flexibility for today's lifestyles. Need even more space? The ground floor offers room for a workshop, ample storage, and direct access to the backyard with a magnificent, mature flowering cherry tree. Enjoy year-round comfort w/ central air conditioning, and benefit from energy-efficient upgrades like a Tesla Powerwall and solar panels. Yes, you can have it all in an A+ location just moments from Miraloma Elementary, Mt. Davidson hiking trails and transportation (36-Teresita muni bus line).
